preset.rule: The sampled pages show a picture-led narrative with large full-page illustrations and short rhyming text, which fits a storybook best.

renderStrategy.rule: The pages rely on large illustrated scenes with text placed over the artwork, so preserving the page image while overlaying accessible text best matches the source.

pageGrouping.rule: The sampled content is presented as facing-page spreads, and the illustrations and text visually continue across the gutter on the paired pages.

sectioningMode.rule: Each sampled page reads as a self-contained page of the narrative rather than a page needing internal splitting into multiple activity sections.

activitiesGenerator.rule: The book appears to be narrative picture-book content with no activity signals or exercise structures to convert interactively.

figureExtraction.rule: The pages contain prominent standalone illustrations and classroom scenes that are good candidates for composite figure handling while still keeping the layout manageable.
